title: The Miraculousness And Testimony Of The Quran 17th Degree The Impossibility Of Producing Its Like In View Of Source Addressee And Purpose

questions.question: What helps us know how special a speech is?
questions.answer: We look at who said it, who it is for, and why it was said.

questions.question: Why does the passage say nothing can match the Qur’an?
questions.answer: Because it comes from Allah, is for a very great messenger, and teaches the biggest truths.

questions.question: Who is the Speaker of the Qur’an in this passage?
questions.answer: Allah, the Lord of all the worlds.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the way the Qur’an speaks?
questions.answer: It says it is real and not fake or copied.

questions.question: Who is the Qur’an especially addressed to?
questions.answer: The Messenger sent for all people, and even for all beings.

questions.question: What happened through that Messenger’s strong faith?
questions.answer: Islam became mighty and honored him greatly.

questions.question: What kinds of happiness does the Qur’an explain?
questions.answer: Happiness in this life and in the next life.

questions.question: What does the Qur’an teach about the universe?
questions.answer: It explains why it was made and the wise purposes in it.

questions.question: The passage compares the universe to three things. What are they?
questions.answer: A map, a clock, and a house.

questions.question: In what way does the Qur’an show the universe?
questions.answer: It shows all its sides clearly and teaches about it like its Maker knows it.

questions.question: Why is making something like the Qur’an impossible, according to the passage?
questions.answer: Because its miraculous level is too high for people to reach.

questions.question: What have many smart scholars written about the Qur’an?
questions.answer: They wrote explanations and commentaries.

questions.question: About how long are some of those commentaries?
questions.answer: Some are thirty, forty, or even seventy volumes.

questions.question: What do those scholars show in their books?
questions.answer: They show many beautiful meanings, fine points, secrets, and signs in the Qur’an.

questions.question: What kind of things in the Qur’an do the books say point to hidden matters?
questions.answer: They say it has many signs about unseen things.

questions.question: What is said about the parts of the Risale-i Nur?
questions.answer: Each part proves one special truth or quality of the Qur’an.

questions.question: Give one example of what some parts of the Risale-i Nur explain.
questions.answer: They explain signs about inventions, electricity, or news about unseen things.

questions.question: What final proof do all these explanations give about the Qur’an?
questions.answer: They show it has no equal, it is a miracle, and it is from the One who knows the unseen.

questions.question: What three questions help us understand the worth of words?
questions.answer: Who said them, who hears them, and why they were said.

questions.question: According to the passage, what makes the Qur’an higher than all other speech?
questions.answer: It is Allah’s speech and has the highest purpose.

questions.question: Is the Qur’an described as copied from others or as fully true and original?
questions.answer: It is described as fully true and original.

questions.question: Who received this message on behalf of everyone?
questions.answer: The Prophet who was sent for all people and all beings.

questions.question: How does the passage describe that Prophet among people?
questions.answer: It says he is the best known and most honored.

questions.question: What did the greatness of his faith help bring about?
questions.answer: It helped bring the strong rise of Islam.

questions.question: What two big areas of life does the Qur’an guide people about?
questions.answer: This world and the next world.

questions.question: Besides happiness, what else does the Qur’an explain about creation?
questions.answer: It explains the results and purposes of creation.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the belief of the one addressed by the Qur’an?
questions.answer: His belief was the widest and highest and held all the truths of Islam.

questions.question: Why are the examples of a map, a clock, and a house used?
questions.answer: To help us see that the Qur’an explains the universe clearly and in an organized way.

questions.question: Who teaches about the universe through the Qur’an, according to the passage?
questions.answer: The One who made the universe.

questions.question: What does the passage say learned scholars have done with the Qur’an?
questions.answer: They wrote many detailed explanations of it.

questions.question: How are those scholars described?
questions.answer: They are careful, knowledgeable, and very intelligent.

questions.question: What kinds of things do their writings bring out from the Qur’an?
questions.answer: Beautiful meanings, special features, secrets, and signs.

questions.question: What is special about the Risale-i Nur in this passage?
questions.answer: Its many sections each prove a truth or wonder of the Qur’an.

questions.question: Name one topic that some parts of the Risale-i Nur are said to discuss.
questions.answer: They discuss signs related to technology, electricity, or unseen news.

questions.question: After giving all these examples, what conclusion does the passage reach?
questions.answer: The Qur’an is unmatched, miraculous, and a message from the unseen world.

questions.question: If we want to know the greatness of speech, what should we think about?
questions.answer: The speaker, the listener, and the purpose.

questions.question: Who is the speaker of the Qur’an in this passage?
questions.answer: Allah, the Creator of the universe.

questions.question: What does the passage say about any hint of pretending in the Qur’an?
questions.answer: It says there is no such pretending in it.

questions.question: Who is the message sent to?
questions.answer: It is sent to the Messenger speaking for all people and all beings.

questions.question: Why is that Messenger’s place so important in the passage?
questions.answer: Because he is greatly honored and has very strong faith.

questions.question: What religion grew strong through his faith?
questions.answer: Islam.

questions.question: What does the Qur’an explain about life?
questions.answer: It explains the good of this life and the next life.

questions.question: What does it explain about the universe itself?
questions.answer: It explains why it was created and what wisdom is in it.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the faith of the one who received the Qur’an?
questions.answer: It was the most complete and far-reaching faith.

questions.question: How does the Qur’an help people understand the universe?
questions.answer: It shows it from every side and teaches about it clearly.

questions.question: Why are human beings unable to produce something equal to the Qur’an?
questions.answer: Because its miracle is beyond human reach.

questions.question: What have many scholars done to help people understand the Qur’an?
questions.answer: They wrote long explanations about it.

questions.question: How long can some of those explanations be?
questions.answer: They can be dozens of volumes long, even up to seventy.

questions.question: What do these explanations prove about the Qur’an?
questions.answer: They prove its many meanings, secrets, and special qualities.

questions.question: Does the passage say the Qur’an only has simple meanings, or also deep ones?
questions.answer: It says it also has deep and elevated meanings.

questions.question: What does each part of the Risale-i Nur do?
questions.answer: It shows one light or truth from the Qur’an.

questions.question: What are some examples of subjects those parts touch on?
questions.answer: Wonders in civilization, electricity, and signs about unseen things.

questions.question: What big idea do all these proofs support?
questions.answer: That the Qur’an is a miracle with no equal and comes from the Knower of the unseen.

questions.question: What makes words important, according to the beginning of the passage?
questions.answer: It matters who said them, who receives them, and what they are for.

questions.question: Why does the passage say the Qur’an stands above every other speech?
questions.answer: Because it is from Allah and has the greatest message.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the Qur’an and imitation?
questions.answer: It says the Qur’an is not an imitation.

questions.question: To whom is the Qur’an directed?
questions.answer: To the Prophet sent for all mankind and all beings.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the Prophet’s name and honor among people?
questions.answer: He is described as very famous and highly honored.

questions.question: What effect did his powerful belief have?
questions.answer: It helped raise Islam strongly.

questions.question: What two worlds does the Qur’an guide us about?
questions.answer: This world and the world to come.

questions.question: What does the Qur’an teach about why the universe exists?
questions.answer: It teaches the results and wise goals of its creation.

questions.question: What kind of belief did the Prophet have, according to the passage?
questions.answer: A belief that was very broad and full of the truths of Islam.

questions.question: How is the universe pictured so children can imagine it more easily?
questions.answer: Like a map, a clock, or a house.

questions.question: Whose way of teaching does the Qur’an use when it explains the universe?
questions.answer: The way of the Maker who created it.

questions.question: What have thousands of scholars done with the Qur’an over time?
questions.answer: They have written careful commentaries about it.

questions.question: What do these commentaries include?
questions.answer: Proofs, reasons, and explanations of many meanings and secrets.

questions.question: What kinds of hidden things are mentioned in the passage?
questions.answer: Matters people cannot see on their own, including unseen realities.

questions.question: What special work is named as giving many proofs about the Qur’an?
questions.answer: The Risale-i Nur.

questions.question: What is said about each section of that work?
questions.answer: Each section shows a special truth or beauty from the Qur’an.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention things like trains, airplanes, and electricity?
questions.answer: To show that some writings draw signs and meanings from the Qur’an about such things.

questions.question: What does the passage finally call the Qur’an?
questions.answer: A unique miracle and a word from the One who knows the unseen.

questions.question: When we judge speech, what three parts should we think about first?
questions.answer: The one who speaks, the one spoken to, and the reason for speaking.

questions.question: What answer does the passage give to the question of whether the Qur’an has an equal?
questions.answer: It says it has no equal.

questions.question: Who speaks in the Qur’an?
questions.answer: Allah, the Lord and Creator of everything.

questions.question: Is the Qur’an described as forced and made-up, or natural and true?
questions.answer: It is described as natural and true.

questions.question: Who receives this message in a special way?
questions.answer: The Messenger sent in the name of all people and all beings.

questions.question: What does the passage say his strong faith led to?
questions.answer: It led to the rise and strength of Islam.

questions.question: What does the Qur’an explain about human happiness?
questions.answer: It explains happiness in both this life and the next.

questions.question: What does it tell about the universe?
questions.answer: It tells why it was created and the purposes in it.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about the Messenger’s belief?
questions.answer: It was very great and included all the truths of Islam.

questions.question: Why does the passage use examples like a map and a house?
questions.answer: To show that the Qur’an makes the universe understandable.

questions.question: According to the passage, who knows best how to explain the universe?
questions.answer: The One who made it.

questions.question: What kind of people wrote many books explaining the Qur’an?
questions.answer: Very smart and learned scholars.

questions.question: How does the passage show that these books are not small?
questions.answer: It says some have many large volumes.

questions.question: What do these books help readers see in the Qur’an?
questions.answer: Its qualities, details, secrets, high meanings, and signs.

questions.question: What does the passage say about signs of unseen matters in the Qur’an?
questions.answer: It says the Qur’an contains many signs about them.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the many parts of the Risale-i Nur?
questions.answer: They each prove a point about the Qur’an with strong evidence.

questions.question: What is one result of all those proofs and explanations?
questions.answer: They confirm that the Qur’an is a marvel.

questions.question: What does the passage say the Qur’an is in the visible world?
questions.answer: It is a message from the unseen world.

questions.question: What can show us the greatness of a speech?
questions.answer: Knowing who said it, who it is meant for, and its purpose.

questions.question: Why can no one bring something just like the Qur’an, according to the passage?
questions.answer: Because it comes from Allah and its miracle is too great.

questions.question: How does the passage describe Allah in relation to the Qur’an?
questions.answer: As the Lord of all worlds and Creator of the whole universe.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the Qur’an and fake copying?
questions.answer: It says the Qur’an has no sign of that.

questions.question: Who is the one being spoken to by the Qur’an?
questions.answer: The Prophet sent for all humanity and all beings.

questions.question: What does the passage say about his place among people?
questions.answer: He is very well known and honored.

questions.question: What did his strong belief help establish?
questions.answer: A powerful Islam.

questions.question: What does the Qur’an explain about the two lives of people?
questions.answer: It explains what brings success in this life and the next.

questions.question: What else does the Qur’an explain about the world around us?
questions.answer: It explains the outcomes and purposes of creation.

questions.question: What pictures are used to help describe the universe?
questions.answer: A map, a clock, and a house.

questions.question: In whose way does the Qur’an describe the universe?
questions.answer: In the way of its Maker.

questions.question: What does the passage say many scholars have done for the Qur’an?
questions.answer: They have written detailed commentaries on it.

questions.question: What are some things those commentaries talk about?
questions.answer: Fine points, special traits, hidden meanings, and signs.

questions.question: Are the meanings of the Qur’an shown as few or many in the passage?
questions.answer: They are shown as many.

questions.question: What is one thing each part of the Risale-i Nur is said to show?
questions.answer: One truth or one light from the Qur’an.

questions.question: What are some examples of topics named from those parts?
questions.answer: Transportation inventions, electricity, and news of unseen things.

questions.question: What do all these scholarly works become in the passage?
questions.answer: A proof-mark showing the Qur’an is unique and miraculous.

questions.question: What final description is given for the Qur’an at the end of the passage?
questions.answer: It is the word of the One who knows the unseen.
